minutes.headline: Parks Commission approved 2021 youth, rental and court user fees; adult fees and field policy deferred.
minutes.summary: The commission set youth, jamboree, grass-field and basketball court rates for 2021, held adult rates for further study, and read a draft field and facility use policy for approval at a later meeting. It also heard a talent bank applicant, discussed the skatepark, Marshall Park short-term fixes and master planning, town property lists, and the parks revolving account.

votes.motion: Approve the user fees as established for youth organizations, special events, jamboree and tournaments, grass field rental and basketball courts (adult rates held back).

votes.outcome: passed by roll call (Dave, Chris, chair aye; Susannah had stepped away)

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted 4-0 by roll call to approve 2021 user fees for youth organizations, special events, jamboree and tournaments, grass field rental and basketball courts.
Adult organization fees were held for a later meeting while the recreation director compares rosters and hours.
The draft field and facility use policy was not approved; the director is to change the wording for approval at the next meeting.
A talent bank applicant is to be voted on at the December 1 joint meeting with the select board.
The chair is to seek the 1984 town meeting article wording, and the recreation director is to present on revolving account types in January.

why_it_matters: The approved fees set what youth leagues, event organizers and renters pay to use town fields and courts in 2021, while adult rates remain undecided.
Whether park user fees go to the general fund or stay with parks is unresolved, and that affects how much fee money is available for park upkeep.

December 14 Zoom meeting: revised field and facility use policy and the held adult fees.
